positive_isolation_already_present.meaning: Most data required for a reentrant restricted solve already exists outside legacy globals. The blocker is residual use of shared module context, not absence of an explicit kernel/solver contract.

decisive_shared_mutable_hazards.finding: bind_b110_serialized_legacy_context writes request-specific values into the shared variables module before every solve.

reference_richards_legacy_solve validates an explicit request against shared module values and then calls HeadCalc; therefore separate backend/workspace objects do not isolate the complete execution context.
HeadCalc still imports and directly consumes legacy module controls while worker/state/provider arguments are present.
examples: dt enters residuals, balances and retry state
fldtmin changes iteration/backtracking and failure behaviour

decisive_shared_mutable_hazards.finding: HeadCalc can assign shared fldtmin=.FALSE. on a nonconverged trajectory. This is a concrete shared write during solver execution, not merely a read-only compatibility dependency.

why_backend_per_worker_is_insufficient: fmr_serialized_reference_backend_t can own independent model/kernel/workspace objects, but those objects converge onto bind_b110_serialized_legacy_context before each HeadCalc solve.
Two concurrent calls may interleave request binding, validation and HeadCalc reads/writes through the same Fortran module storage.
A worker-local a23bu_worker_context_t protects Newton/scratch/diagnostic arrays but does not make variables/MOD_* module storage thread-local.
Therefore worker_count>1 cannot be admitted by merely allocating multiple backend instances.

restricted_profile_nuance.conclusion: The remaining blocker is narrower than full SWAP global-state removal, so a bounded canonical-path isolation refactor is plausible. It still requires edits to existing solver/adapter/HeadCalc source and must be independently qualified.

minimum_isolation_refactor.goal: Make the canonical restricted HeadCalc path reentrant without changing legacy standalone semantics.
steps: Pass request step_duration, boundary conditions and soil_water_numerical_config explicitly into the canonical HeadCalc execution path instead of rebinding them through variables.
Replace canonical fldtmin use with worker%control%at_min_dt and keep dt-reduction requests in worker/state-local control.
Replace canonical fldaystart dependence with worker%time%day_start_event; no hidden calendar read is allowed.
Use request parameters/state binding for canonical per-column state and keep provider-owned constitutive/source/top data explicit.
Stop calling bind_b110_serialized_legacy_context from the canonical restricted backend once all required mutable controls are explicit; retain it only for legacy-adapter execution where necessary.
For the first concurrent admission, require one homogeneous frozen grid/layout per concurrent batch; do not rebind MOD_grid between workers.
Add a source gate proving the canonical path has no mutable variables-module read/write dependencies before any OpenMP/thread worker execution is enabled.
Then run 1/2/4/8-worker exact committed-state, mass, diagnostics, order and repeatability qualification against the MQ23 reference.
